goal: Validate the stabilized workflow through ten bounded sanitized multi-turn foreground scenarios and persist truthful source-bound provider evidence, offline checks and release results.

acceptance.assertion: Implement S7 of docs/specs/workflow-decision-closure.spec.md. Reuse the benchmark collector/record path for the complete ten-scenario cohort, one supported disclosed Host model, serial foreground dispatch, one attempt per scenario, no nesting or auto-retry. Resolve exact model/authorized budget first and perform live runs outside deterministic QA; use simulated authority/publication seams, never real commits, Issue writes or Enrollment as scenario effects. Independently inspect concrete transcript decisions/calls; record sanitized complete outcomes, contract/fixture/source hashes, provenance and available Host metrics, marking unknown cost/telemetry and incomparable baselines honestly. Persist source-bound live evidence and a concise report; offline tests fail on missing/failed/duplicate/contract-only outcomes or fingerprint/provenance drift and must not call a model. Preserve legacy benchmark modes and negative controls. Required typecheck/build/release checks also pass before Review. Static-only checks or absent live evidence leave S7 and the Initiative incomplete; this bounded cohort does not claim universal Host/provider correctness or fix external H1.
